scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:stand: docker compose -p ferrum-test --env-file docker-compose.test.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres valkey mailpit
scripts.test:server: npm run test:stand && cd packages/protocol && bun test && cd ../../apps/server && bun test
scripts.test:stand:down: docker compose -p ferrum-test --env-file docker-compose.test.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
